Type: stool
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Julian Mid-Century Barstools, Set of 2, 37.8"H, Grey
Colors: Grey
These low-back barstools feature a minimalist mid-century design with padded seats and backs. Sturdy steel construction includes geometric open-style legs. 19.3"W x 21"D x 37.8"H; seat height: 29"H; seat dimension: 16" x 14" Fabric upholstery on wood frame with steel legs The fabric seat and powder-coated finish on the metal legs make for easy care and durability. Grey upholstery is stylishly paired with a slender grey steel frame and geometric legs. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Clean by vacuuming or wiping with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
